ترتهنين (form VIII)
# تَرْتَهِنِينَ (tartahinīna) /tar.ta.hi.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# تُرْتَهَنِينَ (turtahanīna) /tur.ta.ha.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
